module: Detects at startup whether the game was just updated to a new major version (comparison of the first two numbers of beamng_version with the lastVersion setting). In that case it runs FS:folderCleanup to back up the user folders of the old version, then stores the current version in the settings. A modder rarely uses it; updatedFromVersion() indicates which version we come from.
usage:
local previous = core_versionUpdate.updatedFromVersion()
if previous then log('I', 'mod', 'updated from ' .. previous) end
notes: New installation (no lastVersion and onlineFeatures == 'ask') or same major version: no backup, unless the folderCleanupRequested setting is true, in which case FS:folderCleanup("") is executed.
If lastVersion is absent but it is not a new installation, the value "0.0.0.0.unknown_before_0.38" is used.
M.updateBackupPath (path returned by FS:folderCleanup) is defined but absent from the list of exported fields; it only exists during a major update.

onUpdate waits for 2 calls (workaround for a settings system bug), then removes itself (M.onUpdate = nil), reruns extensions.hookUpdate('onUpdate') to rebuild the hook list, writes lastVersion and clears folderCleanupRequested.

lastVersion.desc: Previous game version if a major update was detected at this launch, otherwise nil.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called on load: compares the current version and the last stored version, optionally runs the folder backup/cleanup and stores lastVersion.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame, but only until the 2nd time: stores the current version in the settings then removes itself.

updatedFromVersion.desc: Returns the version we just migrated from.

returns.desc: Old version, nil if there was no major update at this launch.
